data.value: Unlike basic time trackers that only count hours, TimeVic is a double-balance financial hub. You record client payments, including upfront deposits without linking them to specific projects, track hours against commercial rates, and the system automatically calculates the Outstanding Balance. You instantly see which client owes you money and when a prepaid balance is fully spent, with no manual spreadsheets required.

data.name: Content_YouCanTrackAsMuchOrAsLittleAsYou
data.value: TimeVic features a built-in Anti-Forget Timer Engine. If a timer runs continuously for over 12 hours, the system automatically stops it at a standard 8-hour mark and sends you a helpful email notification. This protects your workspace analytics and client reports from distorted figures, allowing you to easily adjust the logged hours manually later.

data.name: Title_DoDevelopersSeeClientRates
data.value: Can my hired freelancers or subcontractors see my client billing rates and agency earnings?

data.name: Content_DoDevelopersSeeClientRates
data.value: No. Complete data isolation is enforced by workspace role. Subcontractors with the User role can only see their tracked hours and their own personal payout report, calculated from their individual internal rate. Client-facing commercial rates, other team members’ rates, and overall workspace profit remain confidential and visible only to Owners and Managers.

data.name: Content_HowDoesCustomCurrencyWork
data.value: You can choose any standard currency (USD, EUR, UAH) or define custom credit units (such as internal workspace coins ₵) for calculations and accounting within your team.

data.name: Content_HowOftenClientReportsUpdated
data.value: With a single click, generate a secure Shared Report link for your client. They can view approved hours, payment history, outstanding balance, and an optional task breakdown in a lightweight guest dashboard, without access to your internal workspace settings or private data.
